sources.source: WHO and ESC/ESH: hypertension is blood pressure 140/90 mmHg or more on repeated measurement (average of the NHANES readings)

sources.name: local_calibration
sources.source: Each score is shifted (intercept only, ranking unchanged) so the average over local adults without that diagnosis matches the expected undiagnosed rate: WHO UAE prevalence (data/real/who) minus the diagnosed share in the records, capped at the published undiagnosed share (config/synthetic_data.json)

sources.name: base_attendance_logit
sources.source: usual care attends 79.2% of booked visits (achieved 0.785); Emirates Health Services primary care, Jul-Sep 2022: 14,038 no-shows of 67,429 booked appointments (JMIR Formative Research 2025)

sources.name: stop_share
sources.source: 2.5% of contacted people opt out (achieved 0.0249); Kaiser Permanente Colorado, JAMA Network Open 2021: 2.5% of adults opted out of automated health texts in a year

definitions.true_case: diabetes or high blood pressure present at the start and not diagnosed (what the two models predict)
definitions.flag: chance at or above the High cut-off (top share of local scores), combined or per condition
definitions.false_positive_rate: flagged High, but not a true case (share of people who are not cases)
definitions.false_negative_rate: a true case, but not flagged High (share of cases); children and people with too little data are not scored and are counted under cases_not_scored
definitions.hidden_found_share: hidden cases present at the start that a visit found by the end of the run
definitions.calibration: each condition's average predicted chance against the observed rate in the same people
definitions.small_groups: groups under 10 people hidden; a rate needs at least 10 people or cases

risk_model.target: chance of undiagnosed diabetes now, from a published questionnaire score
risk_model.method: FINDRISC points scaled to the UAE undiagnosed level. Nothing is trained: the points and bands are published
risk_model.source: Lindstrom J, Tuomilehto J. The diabetes risk score. Diabetes Care 2003;26:725-731

diabetes.label: Diabetes (HbA1c 6.5% or more in an adult never told they have diabetes)
diabetes.range: from the points the missing items could add; a person is never scored as if they were known

validation.score: FINDRISC as used in this prototype (no waist)

hypertension.label: High blood pressure
hypertension.score: none: blood pressure is measured, so a high reading is a finding (an abnormal-result card), not a prediction

risk_model.cutoff_rule: High = top 15% of local scores, Moderate = top 40%

nhanes.test: NHANES 2015-2023 adults never told they have diabetes (real survey data)
nhanes.label: HbA1c 6.5% or more

scores.name: FINDRISC, every item NHANES has (6 of 8)
scores.items: age, BMI, waist, treated for high blood pressure, ever told of high blood sugar, close relative with diabetes
scores.source: Lindstrom J, Tuomilehto J. The diabetes risk score. Diabetes Care 2003;26:725-731

scores.name: FINDRISC as used in this prototype (no waist)
scores.items: age, BMI, high blood pressure diagnosis, told of high blood sugar, family history; the missing items widen the range
scores.source: Lindstrom J, Tuomilehto J. The diabetes risk score. Diabetes Care 2003;26:725-731

scores.name: ADA diabetes risk test (5 of 7 items)
scores.items: age, sex, family history, high blood pressure, BMI
scores.source: Bang H et al. Development and validation of a patient self-assessment score for diabetes risk. Ann Intern Med 2009;151:775-783

headline.score: FINDRISC as used in this prototype (no waist)

nhanes.note: Nothing is trained: the points are the published ones, filled in only where NHANES has the answer, so a full questionnaire would do a little better. None was built for the UAE. The check shows how well the score ranks real people on data it was not tuned to.

noshow_model.support_planned_by: rule: access barrier and past missed visits (no learned model)

ai_ablation.note: Averages over the seeds. rules_only is the system without the channel learner.
